name: steam-reviews-scraper
title: Steam Reviews Scraper – Steam API, Steam Player Count, Playtime
description: Steam player reviews and store data to JSON/CSV: review text, playtime, thumbs up/down, helpfulness votes, purchase type. Filter by playtime, keyword, language or review type, or include the off-topic review bombs Steam hides; games mode adds price, genres, player count, owner estimates and tags.
